description: This is a large, rectangular rug with a rich, intricate design. The dominant color is a deep crimson or burgundy, which serves as the background for elaborate floral patterns and a central medallion. The medallion is circular and features a lighter, creamy beige color with delicate blue and white detailing. Surrounding the central medallion is a dense field of floral motifs in shades of crimson, beige, and hints of muted orange and green. The rug has a decorative border that frames the central design, also incorporating floral elements and geometric patterns in complementary colors. The edges of the rug are finished with a fringe, appearing to be made of natural fibers like cotton or wool, adding a touch of texture and tradition. The overall impression is one of luxury, craftsmanship, and classic elegance.
